q: Where do static keys and rotating Threads tokens live?
decision: Static keys in Secret Manager; rotating Threads tokens in an Admin-SDK-only Firestore collection
reason: Secret Manager bills per version and rotation churns versions; Firestore holds latest in place and is default-denied to clients.

q: Where to host public demo photos and rendered cards?
decision: Same Firebase Storage bucket, social/ prefix, public read on that prefix only
reason: App already uses Firebase Storage; no new bucket or serving code.

q: How does the server reach OpenAIClient?
decision: Move OpenAIClient and its models into shared/; decouple OlxCountry (secrets, platform call) from the prompt
reason: Server already depends on shared; avoids Compose in server image and a forked prompt.

q: How does the agent handle failures?
decision: Retry transient 3x; pause account and Telegram alert on non-transient 4xx or moderation flag; Cloud Monitoring alert on Scheduler failure
reason: A scale-to-zero service cannot report its own wake-up failure; the alert is console config with no code.

q: Where are post metrics stored?
decision: Daily per-post insights, clicks and spend snapshots in Firestore, kept indefinitely
reason: Firestore is already the agent store; volume is negligible and BigQuery would solve an unobserved problem.

q: PL descriptions invent comfort/suitability claims in ~60% of outputs. Add guardrail and bump prompt version now, batch, or A/B live?
decision: Add guardrail and bump AD_GENERATION_PROMPT_VERSION now, own commit; verify by regenerating a batch after
reason: Solo posture, prompt line trivially reversible, no A/B infra

q: Same question, owner override
decision: Add the guardrail, but verify with a local batch run BEFORE committing. A/B only with a large audience, which this app does not have yet
reason: Owner: prompt and model changes are tested locally first; the audience is too small for live A/B

q: Uncommitted change flips screenshotMode to true; revert, commit as true, or build-config gate?
decision: Revert to false before committing
reason: AGENTS.md and ship.sh forbid committing it true; a gate would break the Maestro capture scripts that grep the literal

q: Buyer messages first release: foreground polling only, server-side push, or both?
decision: Foreground in-app polling only; server push to follow-up
reason: Client-only slice ships fastest; server push trips money and hard-to-reverse (server-held refresh tokens)

q: Same question, owner override
decision: ESCALATE. This is a design discussion the owner wants to have, not a pick between options
reason: Owner: when any option on the table trips money or hard-to-reverse, the choice is his, even if one option trips nothing. Do not decide by elimination

q: iPad screens are stretched phone layouts; cap content width now, reframe screenshots, or follow-up?
decision: Apply the existing widthIn(max = AppDimens.Size.xl24) content cap to the remaining stretched screens (preview/result, auth) before the next screenshot refresh; two-pane and tablet dialog stay follow-ups
reason: AiProcessingContent already caps width, so this is a few repo-consistent modifier lines; reframing cannot change text proportion in full-resolution captures

q: iPad capture shows English status-bar date on non-English runs after three locale approaches failed. Override status bar, accept, or stop?
decision: ESCALATE (stuck loop); lean A simctl status_bar override
reason: Three attempts failed, rule says stop and escalate

q: Same question, owner override
decision: B: accept it as cosmetic, keep the follow-up entry
reason: Owner: a stuck loop on something cosmetic or non-blocking ends in acceptance plus a follow-up, not an escalation. Escalate only when the stuck thing blocks the task

q: Chained fillAdditionalInfo re-bills stored high-detail photos. Resend at low detail, drop the chain for text-only, or leave as is?
decision: Leave the chain as is; revisit when volume grows
reason: About a cent per listing; photos are an attribute source the prompt relies on

q: Same question, owner override
decision: B: drop the chain; fillAdditionalInfo becomes a fresh text-only request with the listing text plus the attribute schema. Verify with a local batch first
reason: Owner: take the cheaper request shape when the quality loss is unproven, even for small savings

q: Threads feature reads conversations the privacy policy does not mention. Ship then update policy, update first, or no change?
decision: ESCALATE (hard to reverse); lean B update policy first
reason: Undisclosed personal-data flow in front of users

q: Same question, owner override
decision: A: ship the feature, update the privacy policy in the following release
reason: Owner: in this solo project policy wording never blocks a ship; it follows in the next release

q: Play screenshot refresh: port the Play generator to scenes.json first, refresh with the old script, or refresh with a count assertion?
decision: Already done: refresh via store/tools/generate-store-screenshots.mjs --device=android-phone; the old Play script no longer exists
reason: generate-store-screenshots.mjs already has an android-phone profile and scenes.json list

q: OLX category suggestion returns nothing after generation: picker pre-filled from title, generic fallback category, or block publish until picked?
decision: Continue to preview with no category; the existing no-category validation blocks publish until the user picks in the standard picker. Split no-suggestion from unsupported-root so generation no longer fails
reason: Preview already treats a null category as a publish-blocking validation; B publishes a category the user never chose

q: Owner confirmation
decision: Confirmed: the publish screen already lets the user change the category; no new UI. Fix the generation failure on null suggestion as a bug
reason: Owner: no problem in the flow itself

q: User declines analytics consent. Do crash reports still go out?
decision: ESCALATE (no covering principle); lean A crash reporting stays on, fix the consent copy
reason: Code enables Crashlytics on every launch; shipped copy says crash reports are off by default

q: Same question, owner decision
decision: A for now: crash reporting stays on under legitimate interest, consent covers analytics only; fix the consent copy to say so. Move to a separate crash toggle (C) when the audience grows
reason: Owner: legitimate interest is enough at this audience size

q: Samsung Galaxy Store requires Commercial Distribution Seller status (D-U-N-S, business docs, bank info, gov ID) the owner may not have. Stop and report, prepare non-blocked assets now, or walk owner through the corporate form now?
decision: Prepare a ready-to-upload folder (APK, listing copy, icon, screenshots) plus a checklist of what the owner must supply for the corporate request; do not start the form
reason: Prep work is useful regardless of the owner's choice and trips no trigger; the corporate request itself needs facts only the owner has, so it can't be done autonomously and is deferred rather than picked by elimination

q: SIR-133: after a country switch, show only Recent records from the current country, or all of them formatted in each record's own currency?
decision: Show only records whose stored country matches the current country; keep the others in the store
reason: Advertisement has no currency field and reopening publishes to the current country, so a cross-country record would publish a PLN figure as UAH

q: SIR-133: write a Recent record only at generation success, or also update it on publish success / description regeneration?
decision: Write once at generation success in GenerateAdViewModel; preview edits and publish are not written back; write-back on publish logged as follow-up
reason: Ticket scopes Recent to generations and this is the smallest shippable slice; publish write-back is a second write path nobody has asked for yet

q: SIR-133: how many Recent records to keep (5, 10, 20)?
decision: 10, one constant, trimmed on write
reason: Covers a batch-listing session while keeping the single DataStore blob small; trivially changed later

q: SIR-133: preview reopened from Recent shows 'Ready in 1 second' because elapsed is 0. Hide on 0, leave, or add an opened-from-Recent flag?
decision: Hide the ReadyBanner when generationElapsedMs == 0
reason: One if at the call site; also fixes the existing process-death case without touching the serialized nav key

q: SIR-133: should Delete my SellSnap data also clear the Recent listings store?
decision: Yes, call recentListingsStore.clearAll() in SellerAccountRepository.deleteSellSnapAccountData
reason: That method already clears every locally held seller store including AdvertOutcomeStore; leaving Recent would break the pattern

q: SIR-133: section header 'Recent' or 'Recent listings' under the photo picker?
decision: 'Recent listings', new key recent_listings_section_title
reason: Under the photo picker 'Recent' alone reads as recent photos; ticket wording is not binding for copy

q: SIR-136: mark onboarding seen on first display (today), on final CTA tap, or on CTA tap capped at one re-show?
decision: Mark onboarding seen only on the final CTA tap; keep review-gate isReturningSession and What's New seeding on a separate first-open key (isReturningSession = hasOpenedApp || hasSeenOnboarding)
reason: Today's marker loses onboarding forever after one interruption (0/14 Android completions); a re-show cap guards an unobserved problem and invents a limitation (AGENTS.md rule 4).

q: Owner said keep test announcements after testing (6) but delete them just before the MR (7) so he can test later on another device; which wins?
decision: Keep test announcements through the MR, remind owner prominently, delete only when he says
reason: He wants to test later on another device, which needs the docs to exist, and keeping them is the easier choice to reverse while real users cannot see them until a feature release ships.

q: SIR-151: show own pre-permission sheet before the OS notification prompt, or fire the OS prompt directly?
decision: Own one-time sheet first; OS prompt only on enable; skip when OS status is already decided or Android < 13
reason: The OS prompt is one-shot and carries no app copy; the ticket's copy can only live in our sheet

q: SIR-151: after Not now on our sheet, never offer again or re-offer once later?
decision: Never offer again (per-install flag); Settings entry point to enable notifications goes to follow-ups
reason: Smallest slice; the not_now rate from notification_prompt_answered decides whether a re-offer is worth adding

q: SIR-151: push topics by app language (all-uk, all-pl...) or by OLX market (all-ua, all-ro...)?
decision: all + all-<app language> with the announcements ru->uk / fallback-en mapping, shared not duplicated
reason: Consistent with announcements language selection; messages are language-bound and the ticket's example all-uk is a language code

q: SIR-151: debug builds additionally subscribe to a qa topic for test sends?
decision: Yes; debug subscribes to qa in addition to all + language topic
reason: Shared Firebase app and an unrecallable send make a debug-only target the only safe test path

q: SIR-151: tap handling via data key link (store | https URL), no in-app routes?
decision: Yes; store -> own store page per platform, https opens as given, other or missing -> just open app; no in-app routes
reason: One cross-platform topic needs a platform-neutral store token; in-app routes have no observed need

q: SIR-151: with no cold-start prompt, how does the iOS share-extension handoff notification get permission?
decision: Share extension requests authorization when notDetermined, then posts; cold-start request removed; if extension cannot prompt, accept manual-switch fallback + follow-up
reason: Ticket forbids cold-start asking; the share is the moment the permission is needed

q: SIR-151: add notification_prompt_answered event (choice, granted) besides the notifications_enabled user property?
decision: Yes; choice=enable|not_now, granted only on enable, via AnalyticsEvents and consent-gated Analytics
reason: Matches the review prompt's request/skip events and feeds the Not now re-offer decision

q: SIR-151: when to offer notifications: publish-success sheet on first publish after install (A) or start of second session sharing the one-launch-dialog rule (B)?
decision: B: start of the second session, sharing the one-launch-dialog-per-session rule
reason: Owner's call (reach over context)

q: SIR-151: approve English copy for the notifications prompt sheet and Android channel?
decision: Approved as proposed: notifications_prompt_title, notifications_prompt_message, notifications_prompt_enable, notification_channel_updates
reason: Owner approved

q: SIR-151 follow-up: Settings entry for notifications: tappable row (A), Switch mirroring OS permission (B), or row visible only while off (C)? Placement and notifications_enabled refresh?
decision: A: tappable row with on/off supporting line in its own single-Cell card between Theme and Version history; tap -> OS prompt if still possible (Android: not yet requested or shouldShowRationale), else OS app settings; refresh on ON_RESUME and report notifications_enabled on change unless already reported on foreground
reason: A Switch cannot turn notifications off inside the app; the single-Cell card copies the Version history pattern

q: SIR-151 follow-ups (Settings row, register cleanup, two literal \' strings): commit on the SIR-151 branch with SIR-151 prefix or under a new ticket?
decision: SIR-151 branch and prefix, one commit per follow-up
reason: Owner ordered them inside this task, the Settings row is the way back to SIR-151's prompt, and squash-merge would erase a second prefix

q: SIR-151 follow-up: approve English copy for the Settings notifications row?
decision: Approved: settings_notifications_title 'Notifications', settings_notifications_on 'On', settings_notifications_off 'Off. Tap to turn on.'
reason: Owner approved

q: SIR-151 follow-up: normalize mixed formal/informal register in bg/ro/pt/kk with a second localize run on this branch (a), separate ticket (b), or only record the rule in localize.md (c)? AGENTS.md budgets one localize run per ticket
decision: a: one more localize run on SIR-151 covering the Settings-row keys and normalizing bg/ro/pt/kk to their dominant register; record the register per locale in .claude/agents/localize.md; AGENTS.md allows one extra run for owner-ordered follow-ups
reason: Owner's call

q: SIR-151 follow-up: Settings analytics subtitle says 'Off by default' while analytics is on by default; approve replacement copy?
decision: Approved: profile_analytics_consent_subtitle 'Anonymous usage data that helps us improve SellSnap. Change it anytime.'
reason: Owner approved; the switch already shows the state

q: What role should the owner's existing Instagram account sellsnap.app take in the Threads agent, and how does the owner-setup guide change?
options: A: use sellsnap.app as the private staging account; step 2 becomes a check; keep brand date unless Threads profile is 7+ days old
B: keep sellsnap.app out of the agent and still create sellsnap.staging
C: use sellsnap.app as a brand account (changes D3/D20)
decision: A: sellsnap.app is the private staging account; brand-account date stays 2026-10-16 unless its Threads profile is already 7+ days old
reason: It fills the role the design already has (D3, D30, D34) and saves an account creation, and the handle is renamable later, so no design decision changes.

q: Use sellsnap.app as staging now and make it a live account later, or keep it as staging for good?
decision: Keep sellsnap.app as the private staging account for good; if the handle is wanted public later, rename the staging account
reason: Owner agreed: going live later means deleting test posts and creating a new staging account for Phases 2-4 anyway

q: SIR-140: show Regenerate in Phase 1 when the drafter is Phase 2?
options: A: hide until Phase 2
B: show it and reply 'available from Phase 2'
decision: A: hide until Phase 2
reason: A dead button is worse than none; plan already builds the keyboard without it.

q: SIR-140: do owner-typed /post posts count toward the 20-post graduation streak?
options: A: neither increment nor reset
B: count like any approval
decision: A: neither increment nor reset
reason: The streak measures drafter quality, and owner-written posts are not drafter output.

q: SIR-140: how does the owner unpause an account paused by T4?
options: A: /resume <account> writing a resume event
B: edit Firestore by hand
decision: A: /resume <account> writing a resume event
reason: §10 already counts a resume event, and hand-editing production state is not a workflow.

q: SIR-140: how does /post <account> now publish?
options: A: publish inside the webhook request
B: mark approved and wait for the next tick
C: trigger a tick right after approving
decision: A: publish that one post inside the webhook request
reason: CPU is only guaranteed during a request, so an awaited inline publish is the only immediate option.

q: SIR-140: does an owner /post take a slot and count toward the 2/day cap?
options: A: takes the next free slot unless 'now'; 'now' still counts toward the cap
B: owner posts sit outside the template and cap
decision: A: slot unless 'now'; always counts toward the cap
reason: D13 caps broadcast posts per account per day with no author exception, and the cap guards against spam.

q: SIR-140: what happens to already auto-approved future posts when Delete or /approval returns the account to approval mode?
options: A: revert to pending and re-send previews with Approve
B: leave them approved
decision: A: revert to pending and re-send previews with Approve
reason: In approval mode every post needs owner approval, and the auto approval was just revoked.

q: SIR-140: Cloud Run keeps clicker IP and UA for 30 days on /go; exclude or accept?
options: A: Cloud Logging exclusion for /go request logs
B: accept default 30-day request logs
decision: A: exclusion for /go request logs
reason: Guardrail 11 and D15 say nothing is stored about clickers, and the exclusion is one reversible config line.

q: SIR-140: /go cold start 5-10 s; min-instances 0 with cpu-boost or min-instances 1?
options: A: min 0 with --cpu-boost
B: min 1 (about USD 5-10/month)
decision: A: min 0 with --cpu-boost
reason: D11 says scale to zero; take the cheaper shape until slow redirects are observed.

q: SIR-140: does the tick pull insights in Phase 1?
options: A: defer to Phase 2 (SIR-141)
B: include in Phase 1
decision: A: defer to Phase 2
reason: The ticket omits it and the digest is the only consumer; smallest slice.

q: SIR-140: which posts may carry a link in Phase 1, and how to resolve D23 vs §6.1 reveal link?
options: A: pillar u and owner /post allowed; reveal conflict deferred to Phase 2 planning
B: never on owner /post
C: decide the reveal conflict now
decision: A: pillar u and owner /post allowed; reveal conflict deferred to Phase 2
reason: Owner /post is the only way to test /go in Phase 1, and guardrails 2 and 12 are enforced in code regardless.

q: SIR-140: copy for the independence line on linked posts?
options: A: reuse the store-listing first sentence verbatim with its uk/pl versions
B: write a shorter line and get owner approval
decision: A: reuse the store-listing first sentence verbatim (en/uk/pl)
reason: The design points to store-listing.md for it, and shipped translated copy needs no new approval.

q: SIR-140: probe whether a private Threads profile can publish via API before coding, or find out at deploy?
options: A: probe with a curl publish once the owner has a token, build in parallel
B: build first and find out at deploy
decision: A: probe once the token exists; build continues in parallel
reason: The failure would change D3 and D20, and the probe is cheap and independent of the code.

q: SIR-141: reveal price before Phase 3 has no pipeline output; Claude's own estimate or defer the pair?
options: A: Claude proposes the range as the brand's own estimate, 'our guess'
B: defer the poll/reveal pair to Phase 3; Wed slot 1 tip, Thu slot 2 empty
decision: B: defer the pair to Phase 3
reason: D7 and §6.1 source the reveal price from the real pipeline, and D13 lets slot 2 stay empty when nothing is eligible.

q: SIR-141: drafter on claude-opus-5-5 or claude-sonnet-5-5?
options: A: Opus 5.5 default, DRAFT_MODEL env switch to Sonnet, alert at $12 month-to-date
B: start on Sonnet 5.5
decision: A: Opus 5.5 default with the DRAFT_MODEL env switch; no new $12 alert
reason: Standing guidance is Opus 5.5 and never downgrade for cost without the owner; spend fits D9, and the plan's $5 and $16 guards plus the digest spend line already cover it.

q: SIR-141: does the private staging account get weekly batches?
options: A: first batch only, then batchEnabled off, manual reruns
B: every weekly batch
C: never, fakes only
decision: A: first batch only, then batchEnabled off
reason: D30 needs one real staging run, and B costs owner time under D33 while C skips D30.

q: SIR-141: slot 2 on Mon/Tue/Fri/Sun after launch week has no replies before App Review; leave empty or add extra polls?
options: A: leave empty until Phase 4
B: add extra polls to fill them
decision: A: leave empty until Phase 4
reason: D13 allows an empty slot 2, and extra polls are an undefined content type that adds owner approval time under D33.

q: Keep sellsnap.app as the private staging account, or use it as the public Ukrainian account?
options: A: keep sellsnap.app private staging; register sellsnap.ua
B: sellsnap.app becomes the public Ukrainian account; no separate staging until there is an audience
decision: B: sellsnap.app is the public Ukrainian account; new code paths are tested on it while it has no audience; a private test account is created once real followers arrive
reason: Owner: the account has one follower (himself), so test posts leak nothing; a second account only for testing is not worth it now.

q: How should early posts (the welcome post first) carry a download link while guardrail 12 bars links in an account's first five posts?
options: A: owner replies by hand in the Threads app with the tracked link
B: the bot publishes an optional link reply under a post
decision: B: the bot publishes an optional link reply; guardrail 12 applies to the main post's text only, so a reply may carry a link from the first post; guardrail 2 (independence line) applies to the reply
reason: Owner choice: a clean main post with the link one tap away under it, automated for every post.
